historicalGuide.classification: Same-product 4399 OL player guide, not an exclusive official FAQ; historical 2022 wording.
usefulObservations: True cardless/colorless Duel is nullifiable; multi-target expansion was observed.
Limited expenditure persists when the skill passes through A to B to C and returns to a previously spent role.
Historical damage-stage grant timing and zero-damage/prevention cases differ from the current then-clause and must not be applied without current support.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Current official hero and client spell 3076
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Only an actual effective-black Slash Use ignores the current target armor if either the actual user or that target qualifies for Yuanchou. Colorless native zero-entity Slash is excluded. Effective identity/color uses native card-use appearance, including conversions and target/actor replacement.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Current official hero and client spell 3077
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Every unconditional native Slash-family CardUseDeclared resolution is counted once for its final actual actor after exact native actor replacement. Physical Slash, converted Slash, cardless Slash and real requested/response Uses count, including before skill acquisition. Merely playing Slash in Duel/AOE or supplying another actor does not become an additional Use.

ruleInterpretation.basis: Implementation inference from current text and complete native Duel order; no current product-specific FAQ found
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Freeze max(1, lifetime Slash count) separately when each actual target first begins its native Duel pair; the same target-based base amount applies in both directions and is reused for extra effect rounds. Grant only after the whole native Use and all target/damage/dying children return. Each actual final recipient still alive receives an independent temporary source even when its effect was nullified or damage prevented. A dead recipient receives no new skill; a paid issuer losing its source or dying does not retract the already issued then-clause.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Permanent limited expenditure and temporary skill lifetime
ruleInterpretation.basis: Limited skill semantics; historical same-product relay observation is compatible, while exact cursor timing is implementation inference
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Spent status belongs to the player and skill for the entire game, not an instance, printed grant, temporary source or content hash. Relays or reacquisition never reset it. Each temporary grant expires after the first subsequent actual TurnStarted of its recipient reaches ActualTurnCursorReturned, including a face-down skipped turn and all same-actual-turn inserted tail phases. Raw TurnEnded alone does not expire it; independent printed or other temporary grants are preserved.

ruleInterpretation.rule: Paid native Duel response children before the then-clause
ruleInterpretation.basis: Implementation inference from the current then-clause and native response completion order, not an exclusive official FAQ
ruleInterpretation.implementation: For an exact issued Juesheng Duel, a real Slash response completes its original entity payment and drains native equipment-leaving recovery, HP, card-movement and dying children before the Duel continues. It does not require an unrelated response-observer skill. Thus Silver Lion or Wooden Ox payment cannot defer these children until after the temporary skill is granted; a paid issuer death still permits the living final recipient to receive the subsequent grant.

verification.scope: True effective black armor bypass including actor replacement and private responses; lifetime native Slash declarations before skill acquisition and both Duel damage directions; actual expanded targets, extra effects, nullification and source-specific next-actual-turn expiry; real Lion/Ox response-payment recovery, source loss, true death before then-grant and permanent limited expenditure; native response-completion regressions and deterministic cold replay. Gallery visually accepted; routine verification is tracked by the owning development task.
